scope: First Store subslice only. New private actual-authority and cross-account reservation records, strict schema11, parked-refresh/mutation exclusions and refusal of legacy native entrypoints. No public producer or activation path.

negative_controls.initial_schema_RED: Current Store refused the proposed format before implementation.
negative_controls.fence_RED: Intermediate implementation admitted held helpers, legacy installation and saved writes.
negative_controls.isolated_claim_omission: Removing delayed-claim guard admitted actual A and reserved B with unchanged selection.
negative_controls.isolated_custody_omission: Removing central custody exclusion allowed held saved credential erasure.
negative_controls.isolated_exclusion_omission: Removing the hold predicate allowed begin/reuse/claim.
negative_controls.method: Only ignored source copies and Go overlays; no shared-source mutations for negative controls.

review.author: Sol 6.1
review.independent: Astra reviewed actual frozen code, connected callers, tests and reported controls; scoped GREEN.
review.root: Read connected Store/helper/mutation and registry paths, then ran full package race, build, vet and lint.

limits: This does not complete issue39 or qualify publication, bootstrap, native coherence, migration or hot activation.
Records cover cross-account holds with current Login revisions; staged same-account relogin needs a reviewed representation before a publisher exists.
ProtectedHomes and other inventory consumers must include actual/source/target authorities before activation.
Current records do not establish observed real native authority by themselves; tests seed private persisted fixtures because production has no setter.
Mac local Store tests do not qualify Linux native behavior or macOS Keychain switching.
Ordinary legacy/profile behavior is retained; new-mode Runtime and legacy read/install/profile-birth/selection paths refuse.
